title: Adaptive Training Loop
definition: A continuous iterative process that optimizes a model by adapting to new data, evaluating performance, and refining the model based on the results.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a robot learning to do tasks. After trying a few tasks, the robot gets feedback on how well it did. Then, the robot practices more and tries again. This process repeats until the robot can perform the tasks well.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A machine learning model is trained in multiple stages, where each stage improves the model's performance based on the results of the previous stage. This iterative process aims to find the best model possible.
difficulty_levels.expert: The adaptive training loop is a sophisticated optimization strategy that utilizes a combination of techniques, such as SFT and DPO, to continually improve a model's performance on specific tasks. This approach allows the model to adapt to changing data and minimize the risk of regressing on previous performance gains.

extra_fields.insight: The adaptive training loop enables a model to learn more effectively and adapt to new data, ensuring it remains relevant and high-performing over time.
